## Checklist for content changes

- [ ] Every Swiss-footprint fact (ownership, development, hosting, infrastructure) has a `basis` and a `source`.
- [ ] Unknown facts are omitted or marked `unknown` — nothing is guessed.
- [ ] `lastVerified` and source `accessed` dates are set.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes (the build validates all references).
